title.en: Bone pain and limping in an 11-year-5-month-old girl

summary.zh-CN: 女孩从膝部疼痛发展为躯干与髋部疼痛，逐渐出现跛行和消瘦，需要整合多发骨病灶。
summary.en: Pain spreads from the knees to the trunk and hip with limping and weight loss, requiring assessment of multiple bone lesions.

finding.en: Leftward trunk and pelvic tilt with limping, sacrococcygeal tenderness and a positive left FABER test; no local redness, warmth or skin breakdown.

prompt.zh-CN: 骨痛与早期记录提示哪条检查方向？
prompt.en: What investigation direction follows from the pain and early records?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 多发骨病变需组织学鉴别，不能按普通生长痛处理
text.en: Multifocal bone lesions require tissue-based differentiation rather than treatment as growing pains

feedback.zh-CN: 椎体和髂骨破坏是重要器质性证据。
feedback.en: Vertebral and iliac destruction provide important structural evidence.

text.zh-CN: 关节间隙正常说明是生长痛
text.en: Normal joint spaces establish growing pains

feedback.zh-CN: 正常间隙不能解释骨内破坏。
feedback.en: Normal joint spaces do not explain destructive bone lesions.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭CRP升高就能确定化脓性关节炎
text.en: CRP elevation alone proves septic arthritis

feedback.zh-CN: 病变分布和正常关节间隙不支持直接作此结论。
feedback.en: Distribution and normal joint spaces do not support that conclusion alone.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 泡沫样组织细胞及免疫表型支持非朗格汉斯组织细胞病，需结合影像并完善分子评估
text.en: Foamy histiocytes and phenotype support a non-Langerhans histiocytosis, integrated with imaging and molecular evaluation

feedback.zh-CN: CD68阳性而CD1a/S100阴性符合报告解释，但未提供分子结果。
feedback.en: CD68 positivity with CD1a/S100 negativity fits the reported interpretation, without supplied molecular results.

text.zh-CN: CD1a阴性反而确证朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症
text.en: Negative CD1a confirms Langerhans cell histiocytosis

feedback.zh-CN: 这与该鉴别所需的免疫证据相反。
feedback.en: This reverses the relevant immunophenotypic distinction.

text.zh-CN: 已证实BRAF V600E阳性
text.en: BRAF V600E is proven positive

feedback.en: The source did not report BRAF testing.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前应怎样讨论进一步管理？
prompt.en: How should further management be discussed today?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 转组织细胞病专科，完善受累器官与分子评估，再讨论个体化治疗
text.en: Refer to histiocytosis specialists for organ staging and molecular assessment before individualised treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 2020共识支持组织与分子评估；儿童罕见病例须专科适用性判断。
feedback.en: The 2020 consensus supports tissue and molecular assessment; rare paediatric cases require specialist judgement.

text.zh-CN: 旧文疗效不佳，所以目前没有任何治疗可能
text.en: Poor historical results mean no treatment options exist today

feedback.zh-CN: 现代分子治疗进展使这一推断过时。
feedback.en: Advances in molecular treatment make that inference outdated.

text.zh-CN: 不查病变范围即可给所有儿童同一靶向药
text.en: Give every child the same targeted drug without staging

feedback.zh-CN: 器官受累、分子信息和儿童适用性均影响选择。
feedback.en: Organ involvement, molecular findings and paediatric suitability affect selection.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明多发骨破坏超过普通关节疼痛解释范围。；承认分子结果、系统器官筛查和长期结局未知。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Multifocal bone destruction exceeds an ordinary joint-pain explanation.; acknowledge Molecular results, systemic organ screening and long-term outcome are unknown. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 本例组织与免疫表型被原报告归为儿童Erdheim–Chester病。
conclusion.en: The source classified the tissue and immunophenotype as paediatric Erdheim–Chester disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 多发骨破坏超过普通关节疼痛解释范围。
keyReasoning.en: Multifocal bone destruction exceeds an ordinary joint-pain explanation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 组织和免疫组化是关键分类证据。
keyReasoning.en: Tissue and immunohistochemistry are key classification evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 缺少分子和器官分期使治疗判断受限。
keyReasoning.en: Missing molecular and organ staging limits treatment decisions.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 病理结果必须与临床影像合并。
避免从单一染色推出全部诊断。
teachingPoints.en: Avoid deriving the complete diagnosis from one stain.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 现代共识改变了旧文的治疗背景。
teachingPoints.en: Modern consensus changes the context of historical treatment discussion.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
